history_caveat: Every pushed version stays in the repository's git history. Turning off open positions stops future publication; it does not remove what was already published.
switch_note: The switch removes the lab's own statement of positions and orders. The rules and the champion are public, so anyone can recompute from public prices what a rule would hold.
